edits.after: How many problems someone solved can be counted; how many they prevented beforehand is often invisible. When a project was delivered can be recorded; the extra thought devoted to its long-term reliability may not appear immediately. How many of their own tasks someone completed can be calculated; the time spent helping others understand, working through conflicts, and preserving knowledge often has no equally clear number.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'coordinating conflicts' while preserving all three measured/unmeasured examples.
edits.before: How many problems someone solved can be counted; how many they prevented beforehand is often invisible. When a project was delivered can be recorded; the extra thought devoted to its long-term reliability may not appear immediately. How many of their own tasks someone completed can be calculated; the time spent helping others understand, coordinating conflicts, and preserving knowledge often has no equally clear number.

edits.after: Being hard to measure does not make these things unimportant.
edits.reason: Untangle the double negative without changing the claim.
edits.before: These things are not unimportant because they are hard to measure.

edits.after: In reality, its evaluation methods keep telling them that the mission can matter only as long as it does not hurt their individual numbers.
edits.reason: Clarify the contextually negative sense of 影响: the point is that mission must not hurt individual metrics, not that it may never improve them.
edits.before: In reality, its evaluation methods continually tell them that the mission can exist only when it does not affect individual numbers.

edits.after: Prevention, care, coordination, learning, and long-term development are easy to miss because their success often looks like “nothing happened.” When there is no accident, it can look as though no work was done; a team operating independently can look like a manager contributing nothing; smoothly transferred knowledge can look like something anyone would have known anyway.
edits.reason: Make the invisible-success argument natural while retaining all five activities and three examples.
edits.before: Prevention, care, coordination, learning, and long-term development are easily overlooked precisely because they often keep results in a state where “nothing happened.” No accident looks like no work; a team operating independently looks like a manager contributing nothing; smoothly transferred knowledge looks like something anyone would have known anyway.

edits.after: A good organization does not give up on assessing the hard-to-measure part. Nor does it mistake the easily measured part for the whole.
edits.reason: Remove the cumbersome former/latter references and distinguish assessment from pretending everything can be reduced to a number.
edits.before: A good organization will neither abandon measurement because the latter is hard to measure, nor treat the former as everything because it is easy to measure.

edits.after: Si la evaluación se reduce a una cifra que no se puede cuestionar, deja fuera demasiado de la persona.
edits.reason: Replace the unnatural 'el lugar de la persona queda excesivamente estrechado'; retain the reduction of the person to a narrow score.
edits.before: Si la evaluación se reduce a una cifra sobre la que no se pueden pedir explicaciones, el lugar de la persona queda excesivamente estrechado.

edits.after: En realidad, su forma de evaluar les está diciendo una y otra vez que la misión solo puede importar mientras no perjudique sus cifras individuales.
edits.reason: Clarify the negative contextual sense of 影响, preserving the mission-versus-individual-metric conflict.
edits.before: En realidad, su forma de evaluar les está diciendo una y otra vez que la misión solo puede existir mientras no afecte a las cifras individuales.

edits.after: This includes where the data came from, what standards apply, which conditions affect the result, and whether the person being evaluated can point out clear errors or omissions. A score that cannot be understood, checked, or appealed can easily become a convenient cover for those making the decisions.
edits.reason: Replace the opaque 'power's most convenient appearance' while retaining data, standards, contextual influences and contestability.
edits.before: This includes where the data came from, what standards apply, which conditions affect the result, and whether the person evaluated can identify clear errors or omissions. A score that cannot be understood, checked, or appealed can easily become power's most convenient appearance.

edits.after: When all the important responses people receive from an organization depend on the same score, they gradually begin to use that score as the measure of who they are. When it rises, they feel they count; when it falls, even their abilities, relationships, and worth outside work seem to shrink.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'explain their own existence' and 'feel worth seeing'; preserve the full feedback-to-self-worth argument and all outside-work dimensions.
edits.before: When every important organizational response is distributed according to the same score, members gradually use that score to explain their own existence. When it rises, they feel worth seeing; when it falls, their abilities, relationships, and value outside work seem to shrink as well.

edits.after: People understand themselves through an organization's responses. If a company consistently recognizes someone only when their output is high, it is teaching them that only this part counts.
edits.reason: The source's 长期 concerns the organization's prolonged pattern of recognition, not a condition that output must remain high over a long period before recognition.
edits.before: People understand themselves through an organization's responses. If a company acknowledges someone only when their output is high over a long period, it is teaching them that only this part counts.

edits.after: It neither protects people from ever having to face their shortcomings nor turns those shortcomings into a reason to write them off.
edits.reason: Replace the mathematical-sounding 'cancel the person out' while preserving both sides of the balanced evaluation claim.
edits.before: It neither protects people so completely that they never face shortcomings, nor enlarges those shortcomings enough to cancel the person out.

edits.after: Eso incluye de dónde proceden los datos, qué criterios se aplican, qué circunstancias pueden afectar al resultado y si la persona evaluada puede señalar errores u omisiones evidentes. Una puntuación que no se puede comprender, contrastar ni impugnar puede convertirse en una cómoda pantalla detrás de la que se ejerce el poder.
edits.reason: Replace the literal and unnatural 'la apariencia más cómoda del poder'; retain all safeguards and the risk of hiding agency behind a score.
edits.before: Eso incluye de dónde proceden los datos, qué criterios se aplican, qué circunstancias pueden afectar al resultado y si la persona evaluada puede señalar errores u omisiones evidentes. Una puntuación que no se puede comprender, contrastar ni impugnar se convierte fácilmente en la apariencia más cómoda del poder.

edits.after: Cuando todas las respuestas importantes de la organización se distribuyen según una misma puntuación, sus miembros empiezan a interpretar su propia existencia a través de ella. Si sube, sienten que cuentan; si baja, parece que también se empequeñecen sus capacidades, sus relaciones y su valor fuera del trabajo.
edits.reason: Use the natural recognition/value sense of being seen, rather than the literal 'merecen ser vistos'.
edits.before: Cuando todas las respuestas importantes de la organización se distribuyen según una misma puntuación, sus miembros empiezan a interpretar su propia existencia a través de ella. Si sube, sienten que merecen ser vistos; si baja, parece que también se empequeñecen sus capacidades, sus relaciones y su valor fuera del trabajo.

edits.after: Las personas se comprenden a sí mismas a través de la respuesta de la organización. Si durante mucho tiempo una empresa solo reconoce a alguien cuando su producción es alta, le está enseñando que únicamente cuenta esa parte de él.
edits.reason: Restore the source's prolonged conditioning pattern, omitted from the incoming Spanish.
edits.before: Las personas se comprenden a sí mismas a través de la respuesta de la organización. Si una empresa solo reconoce a alguien cuando su producción es alta, le está enseñando que únicamente cuenta esa parte de él.

edits.after: When someone sincerely believes in a shared goal, they may sometimes choose not to insist on every usual boundary. Such commitment should not simply be regarded as exploitation. Work can go beyond exchange precisely because, at certain moments, people are willing to put more of themselves into a common undertaking.
edits.reason: 'Count every boundary' is a literal calque; preserve voluntary generosity without equating it automatically with exploitation.
edits.before: When someone sincerely believes in a shared goal, they may sometimes be willing not to count every boundary. Such commitment should not simply be regarded as exploitation. Work can go beyond exchange precisely because, at certain moments, people are willing to put more of themselves into a common undertaking.

edits.after: Has it been recognized? Have later arrangements allowed the person to recover? Has the workload been redistributed as a result? As their abilities grow, do their decision-making authority, pay, and opportunities to develop change accordingly? Or do the demands alone rise while everything else stays the same?
edits.reason: Naturalize the restoration and decision-space questions; retain recognition, recovery, redistribution, authority, pay and development opportunities.
edits.before: Has it been noticed? Has provision been made afterward to restore what was spent? Has the workload consequently been redistributed? As ability grows, do decision-making room, compensation, and opportunities for growth change accordingly? Or do requirements alone rise while everything else stays the same?

edits.after: A good organization distinguishes three situations.
edits.reason: The following paragraph distinguishes categories of work, not a hierarchy of three levels.
edits.before: A good organization distinguishes three levels.

edits.after: Some tasks were already part of the role but had not been fully taken on before. Others are short-term exceptions, which need clear time limits and room to recover afterward. Still others have become long-term needs; these should be built into formal responsibilities, resources, and compensation, rather than kept afloat indefinitely on personal goodwill.
edits.reason: Make all three categories idiomatic and retain the requirement for recovery after temporary exceptions and formal resources/rewards for lasting needs.
edits.before: Some things were always within the role but had not previously been fully undertaken; others are short-term exceptions requiring clear time limits and recovery; still others have become long-term needs and should formally enter duties, resources, and rewards rather than borrowing personal goodwill forever.

edits.after: Hay tareas que ya forman parte del papel y que la persona no había asumido por completo; otras son excepciones temporales que necesitan un plazo claro y un margen de recuperación posterior; y otras se han convertido en necesidades permanentes y deberían incorporarse formalmente a las responsabilidades, los recursos y las compensaciones, en vez de seguir tomando prestada para siempre la buena voluntad individual.
edits.reason: Returning to normal is not by itself the recovery required by the source; retain an explicit recovery allowance after extra effort.
edits.before: Hay tareas que ya forman parte del papel y que la persona no había asumido por completo; otras son excepciones temporales que necesitan un plazo claro y un retorno a la normalidad; y otras se han convertido en necesidades permanentes y deberían incorporarse formalmente a las responsabilidades, los recursos y las compensaciones, en vez de seguir tomando prestada para siempre la buena voluntad individual.

edits.after: People start hiding how fast they can really work, keeping time-saving methods to themselves, and becoming reluctant to make processes run too smoothly. Every improvement, after all, brings them more to do instead of a lighter load.
edits.reason: Avoid the ambiguous scope of 'Every improvement will not reduce'; retain all three defensive behaviors and the reason for them.
edits.before: Members begin to hide their real speed, avoid sharing time-saving methods, and resist making processes too smooth. Every improvement will not reduce their burden, but merely prove they can undertake more.

edits.after: Some tasks disappear while new demands for oversight and learning arise; work becomes faster but may consume attention more intensively; systems perform parts previously judged by people, while people take responsibility for checking for errors in those systems.
edits.reason: 'Checking the systems' errors' suggests inspecting already-known errors; the source concerns the human responsibility to check systems for errors.
edits.before: Some tasks disappear while new demands for oversight and learning arise; work becomes faster but may consume attention more intensively; systems perform parts previously judged by people, while people assume responsibility for checking the systems' errors.

edits.after: The organization makes investments and is entitled to higher productivity. Members contribute experience, adapt to new tools, and bear the costs of change; they, too, should gain room to learn, recover, and exercise judgment. The precise distribution can vary, but organizational gains cannot be treated as automatic while people's recovery, learning, and compensation are treated as extra requests.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'bear changes' and 'corresponding room' using the article's already stated learning/recovery/judgment dimensions; preserve investment, productivity and non-equal distribution.
edits.before: The organization makes investments and is entitled to higher productivity; members contribute experience, adapt to new tools, and bear changes, and should gain corresponding room. The precise distribution can vary, but organizational gains cannot be regarded as natural while human recovery, learning, and compensation are treated as extra requests.

edits.after: But the moment time is saved, it should not automatically all belong to whoever has the authority to assign the work.
edits.reason: Clarify the temporal attachment and the arrangement authority in direct English.
edits.before: But it certainly should not automatically belong entirely to the party with the authority to make arrangements at the moment efficiency appears.

edits.after: Algunas tareas desaparecen y surgen nuevas exigencias de supervisión y aprendizaje. El trabajo se acelera, pero puede requerir un consumo más intenso de atención. Partes que antes dependían del juicio humano pasan a manos del sistema, y las personas asumen la responsabilidad de comprobar si el sistema comete errores.
edits.reason: Make checking for system errors explicit, not merely 'comprobar sus errores'; retain every changed-work condition.
edits.before: Algunas tareas desaparecen y surgen nuevas exigencias de supervisión y aprendizaje. El trabajo se acelera, pero puede requerir un consumo más intenso de atención. Partes que antes dependían del juicio humano pasan a manos del sistema, y las personas asumen la responsabilidad de comprobar sus errores.

edits.after: Shared work cannot depend forever on one person. Knowledge must be passed on, responsibilities distributed, and roles kept functioning after members leave. If a company cannot act because one person rests, falls ill, or changes direction, that is not the highest acknowledgment of the person's worth. It means the organization has failed to build the capacity to function without relying on that one person.
edits.reason: Replace the vague 'not completed its own development' with the organizational-capacity point already established by the paragraph's examples.
edits.before: Shared work cannot depend forever on one person. Knowledge must be passed on, responsibilities distributed, and roles kept functioning after members leave. If a company cannot act because one person rests, falls ill, or changes direction, that is not the highest acknowledgment of the person's worth. It means the organization has not completed its own development.

edits.after: The work therefore needs to be able to pass to other hands.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'needs to be capable of being taken over' while retaining functional succession.
edits.before: Work therefore needs to be capable of being taken over.

edits.after: That may look more flexible in the short term, but over time it makes a sense of belonging hard to build.
edits.reason: Naturalize the awkward 'makes any belonging difficult to form' without changing the short-term/long-term contrast.
edits.before: The latter may be more flexible in the short term, but makes any belonging difficult to form over time.

edits.after: Someone may believe that, because they were important in the past, the organization must preserve their old position no matter what. But shared goals and practical conditions change, and a particular kind of work may no longer be needed. Real contributions in the past do not give someone automatic control over every future arrangement.
edits.reason: Make the final claim about past contributions and future authority readable while preserving the qualification against permanent ownership of a position.
edits.before: Someone may believe that, because they were important in the past, the organization must preserve their old position no matter what. But shared goals and practical conditions change, and a particular kind of work may no longer be needed. The reality of the past does not automatically acquire authority over every future arrangement.

edits.after: The work needs to be able to pass to someone else because an organization has to continue beyond any one person's time in it.
edits.reason: Clarify organizational continuity beyond a person's tenure, rather than leave a possible lifespan reading.
edits.before: Work can be replaced because organizations need to endure beyond any individual.

edits.after: Si siempre se puede encontrar a otra persona, no hace falta invertir de verdad en su desarrollo; si el puesto importa más que la persona, no hace falta responder a sus discrepancias; si su marcha no afecta al sistema, tampoco parece necesario ajustar el trabajo para cuidar su salud y respetar sus límites.
edits.reason: Clarify that the criticized omission is adapting the work for people's health/boundaries, not changing the health or boundaries themselves.
edits.before: Si siempre se puede encontrar a otra persona, no hace falta invertir de verdad en su desarrollo; si el puesto importa más que la persona, no hace falta responder a sus discrepancias; si su marcha no afecta al sistema, tampoco parecen merecer ajustes su salud o sus límites.

edits.after: Dispone de información que solo ella conoce, asume tareas que solo ella puede completar y demuestra una y otra vez, en las crisis, que la organización no puede prescindir de ella. Esa posición aporta influencia y reconocimiento, pero también puede convertirse en una nueva atadura.
edits.reason: 'Acapara' implies deliberate hoarding, whereas the source only says the person holds knowledge known only to them; retain influence, recognition and constraint.
edits.before: Acapara información que solo ella conoce, asume tareas que solo ella puede completar y demuestra una y otra vez, en las crisis, que la organización no puede prescindir de ella. Esa posición aporta influencia y reconocimiento, pero también puede convertirse en una nueva atadura.

edits.after: Alguien puede creer que, por haber sido importante en el pasado, la organización debe mantener su puesto original en cualquier circunstancia. Pero el objetivo común y las condiciones reales cambian, y un trabajo puede dejar de ser necesario. Lo que de verdad se aportó en el pasado no da automáticamente derecho a decidir todos los acuerdos del futuro.
edits.reason: Naturalize 'la realidad del pasado' and avoid making 'toda la organización del futuro' sound like a different claim about organizational structure.
edits.before: Alguien puede creer que, por haber sido importante en el pasado, la organización debe mantener su puesto original en cualquier circunstancia. Pero el objetivo común y las condiciones reales cambian, y un trabajo puede dejar de ser necesario. La realidad del pasado no adquiere automáticamente el poder de decidir toda la organización del futuro.

Puede significar más margen de decisión, tiempo de aprendizaje expresamente reservado, un ajuste razonable de la carga de trabajo o un registro fiel de lo aportado, en lugar de que, tras mejorar la eficiencia, parezca que la persona «tampoco ha hecho tanto».
edits.after: Puede significar más margen de decisión, tiempo de aprendizaje expresamente reservado, un ajuste razonable de la carga de trabajo o un registro fiel de lo aportado, en vez de infravalorar esa contribución porque, al mejorar la eficiencia, parezca que la persona «tampoco ha hecho tanto».
edits.reason: Synchronize root clarification of the incomplete Chinese sentence: do not undervalue the contribution because efficiency makes the visible effort look smaller. Preserve all four forms of recognition. Root supplies the English at this coordinate; not duplicated here.

review_scope.reading_basis: Read every paragraph and title of the formal ZIP Chinese, English and Spanish manuscripts for work11–15 in bounded untruncated outputs. Total729 body-paragraph readings. No unread body paragraphs. Alignment and Markdown correspondence checked by the intake helper.
review_scope.semantic_review: Compared the full argument, examples and qualifications in each edition. Retained numbers and judgment as mutual checks; the positive role of fair metrics; employee answerability for actual problems; recognition versus identity; voluntary extra effort versus owed duties; recovery after temporary exceptions; shared efficiency gains without equal-split assumptions; and replaceable roles versus disposable people. No condensed rewrites, paragraph deletions or added external facts.
review_scope.local_scope: Natural-language repairs and precision in already supplied content, including long-term organizational recognition versus long-term high-output qualification, health/work adjustments rather than adjusting the person, holding knowledge versus deliberate hoarding, and checking systems for errors. Root subsequently clarified the incomplete Chinese sentence in essay14 paragraph30; read full root ZH/Hant/EN correction and localized it into Spanish. Root supplies that English coordinate, not repeated here.
review_scope.metadata: Five English titles remove numeric prefixes and are naturalized where needed; Spanish13 title polished. Other Spanish titles are already natural and unnumbered.
review_scope.limits: Normative editorial and fidelity review, not an independent legal, medical or empirical factcheck. No translation service. Did not execute supplied HTML scripts or edit ZIP/repo, commit, integrate or publish.
review_scope.root_source_synchronization: Work14p30 Spanish explicitly synchronized; Work15p17 Spanish already accurate and retained. English15p17 is identical to the root-adjudicated text and is supplied solely by the root plan, not duplicated here.
